messages:
ellie (devex): Quick one — our TypeScript quickstart errors on Edge: 'Cannot use import statement outside a module'. Works in local pnpm workspace. anyone seen types + exports cause this?
omar (eng-runtime): sounds like the bundler resolved a file that isn't ESM. Often package.exports or missing 'import' conditional causes edge optimizer to pick CJS or a transpiled file.
dave (pkg): our package.json had types: 'types/index.d.ts' and exports: {"./*":"./lib/cjs/*",".":"./lib/cjs/index.js"} because we only had a cjs build earlier. we added esm later but forgot to update exports.
sasha (ts): TS note: editors in a workspace follow source via symlink, so diagnostics look fine locally. When installed from registry consumers hit the built files. If types point to types/index.d.ts but the published bundle has types under lib/esm, the TS resolution can mismatch.
ellie (devex): pasted minimal bad exports (redacted): ```json
{"exports": {"./*":"./lib/cjs/*",".":"./lib/cjs/index.js"}, "types":"types/index.d.ts"}
```
omar (eng-runtime): that's the culprit. Replace root export with conditional {"import":"./lib/esm/index.js","require":"./lib/cjs/index.js"} and remove the wildcard that forces subpaths to cjs. add "./package.json":"./package.json" too.
dave (pkg): republished patch with conditional exports and moved types to lib/esm/index.d.ts. pack-bot, can you verify the tarball contains lib/esm?
pack-bot: npm pack created package.tgz; tar contents include lib/esm/index.js and lib/esm/index.d.ts and lib/cjs/index.js — OK.
sasha (ts): also ensure "types" points at the published d.ts next to the export (lib/esm/index.d.ts). add a CI check: npm pack -> tar -tf -> rg 'lib/esm' and fail if missing.
ellie (devex): app-side tip for quickstarts: set bundler mainFields to ['exports','module','main'] so import conditionals are honored on build.
omar (eng-runtime): if someone still hits module resolution oddities with pnpm hoists, temporary workarounds: public-hoist-pattern or --shamefully-hoist, but prefer fixing packages.
dave (pkg): added prepublish-check and updated PR checklist. thanks for the quick help — redeploying edge sample now. :rocket:
ellie (devex): redeploy green. leaving a short note in the quickstart README and closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
